answer: Verifying every claim is ruinous; sampling a few is nearly free. Each epoch the ledger draws a random slice of settled transactions and asks a rival operator to re-audit them against ground truth. A honest operator can afford spot checks because his records match reality; a bot farm cannot keep a thousand alibis consistent under random gaze. A lagoon looks calm while the reef underneath hides the cluster, and a fraud as small as a walnut shell, once sampled, quarantines every wallet that shares its operating history.
